settings.title: Verification Settings
settings.helpText: When enabled, validate x5c certificate chain from Wallet Attestation using registered CA certificates. When disabled, only perform signature verification and skip trust anchor validation.

certMatchingSettings.title: Certificate Matching Settings
certMatchingSettings.helpText: When enabled, verify that the public key of the x5c certificate in Wallet Attestation matches one of the registered trusted certificates.

import.title: Import CA Certificate
import.rootCertHelp: Enter the root certificate in PEM format for the CA that issued Wallet Provider certificates.

certImport.title: Import Trusted Certificate
certImport.certHelp: Enter the certificate issued by CA in PEM format. The public key of this certificate will be used for matching.
